Records sort uses tuple (0 if expired else 1, days_until) — verified ascending within group; expired before expiring.

Compliance.jsx filters use useMemo correctly; module + status filters compose properly.
Hub.jsx uses Promise.allSettled for stats + compliance — good fault tolerance; widget shows '—' while loading.
Minor enhancement: when records list is empty (all-clear state), the at-risk table empty state copy is good ('No records match this filter. All clear on this slice.').
